description: This PHP class defines a client for interacting with the Amazon Comprehend service within the AWS SDK, including method signatures for various language processing operations.

classes.name: ComprehendClient
classes.description: A client class to call AWS Comprehend APIs, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: batchDetectDominantLanguage
methods.description: Detects the dominant language in a batch of text documents.

methods.name: batchDetectEntities
methods.description: Detects named entities in a batch of text documents.

methods.name: classifyDocument
methods.description: Classifies a document using a custom classifier.

methods.name: detectSentiment
methods.description: Detects sentiment in a text document.

methods.name: startPiiEntitiesDetectionJob
methods.description: Starts a job to detect PII entities in documents.
